summary.conditions: Final calibrated actual factory values; one held note; velocity0.8, pressure0, no release tail. Rank isolation changes only actual mix control, with float32-weighted reconstruction. All outputs unnormalized stereo IEEEfloat. Core role thresholds match the existing character suite, with velocity0.8 for this matrix rather than its strike velocity0.9.
summary.scope: Tests air/strike roles at representative notes across rates, not arbitrary notes/polyphony or perceptual identity. Sample-rate waveforms are not expected to be bit-identical; noise and filter responses may differ.
